authMode.title: How Data Cloud Inspector signs in
authMode.description: session-or-oauth (default): the Salesforce session already in the browser, or Log in with OAuth. oauth-only: never read the browser session cookie; only OAuth logins through the org's External Client App.

allowedOrgDomains.title: Orgs the extension may call
allowedOrgDomains.description: My Domain hosts, for example acme.my.salesforce.com, or *.acme.my.salesforce.com for every host under it (sandboxes use acme--name.sandbox.my.salesforce.com). Empty or missing: any org.

disableCache.title: Keep no cache after the browser closes
disableCache.description: true: org metadata caches and Health results are kept in session storage only.

disableDiagramforce.title: Turn off Open in Diagramforce
disableDiagramforce.description: true: no diagram is ever handed to diagramforce.com.

disableFeedbackUpload.title: Do not send feedback to the developer's service
disableFeedbackUpload.description: true: the Feedback form only opens an email in the user's mail app; nothing is posted to the feedback service.
